answers.answer: They organized a sit-in (dharna) to demand removal of toll charges at a toll plaza near Darapur village on Ferozpur road in Moga, Punjab.
Their viability as an activism group stems from being led by affected farmers themselves.
Removal of toll charges at the Darapur toll plaza

They organized an indefinite dharna (sit-in) to protest central government policies and demand toll-free plaza, MSP guarantee, debt waiver, withdrawal of electricity amendment bill 4040, punishment for Lakhimpur Kheri incident perpetrators, compensation/jobs for families of farmers killed in Delhi Chalo agitation, and restoration of right to peaceful struggle.
